reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Billing dispute tickets roughly doubled from a ~600/month baseline to ~1200/month in Aug-Sep 2026 (E-05); the majority of disputed bills are tied to ACTUAL meter reads rather than estimated ones (E-02), which rules out tariff change (E-03) and response-speed/SLA issues (E-04) as causes.
